freeTierSummary.zh-CN: 注册并完成实名认证后赠送一个月 RouterCode PLUS 订阅（活动口径：并发上限 10，每周约 2.5 亿 TCredits、订阅总额度约 10 亿 TCredits，实际额度与有效期以控制台为准）。平台是统一 LLM 网关，一把 API Key 可调用 Claude、GPT、Gemini、DeepSeek、Qwen、GLM 等 400+ 模型，兼容 OpenAI Chat Completions / Responses 与 Anthropic Messages；部分高阶模型要求 PLUS 及以上套餐。
freeTierSummary.en: Sign up and pass real-name verification for a free one-month RouterCode PLUS subscription (concurrency 10, about 250M TCredits/week and about 1B in total; the granted quota is shown in the console). One API key reaches 400+ models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, ...) through an OpenAI Chat Completions / Responses and Anthropic Messages compatible gateway; some models need PLUS or higher.

zh-CN: 通过邀请链接注册 APIGOTO 账号（支持邮箱或手机号注册）
登录后在个人中心提交个人实名认证，认证通过即可获得一个月 RouterCode PLUS 订阅额度
在后台「API 密钥」页面创建 Key（形如 sk-routercode-…，明文只显示一次，请立即保存）
Base URL 填 https://api.apigoto.com/v1，model 填平台模型 ID（如 claude-opus-5-5）即可调用；公开模型清单见 https://api.apigoto.com/api/v1/user/user/models
en: Sign up for an APIGOTO account through the invite link (email or phone)
Complete personal real-name verification in the user center to receive one month of RouterCode PLUS quota
Create an API key on the console "API Keys" page (format sk-routercode-..., the plaintext is shown only once)
Use https://api.apigoto.com/v1 as the base URL and a platform model id (for example claude-opus-5-5); the public model list is at https://api.apigoto.com/api/v1/user/user/models
